supersededAttempt.change: Limit unresolved-import diagnostic paths to the first eight plus remaining count.
supersededAttempt.effect: All non-dynamic fixtures have no unresolved import and dynamic fixture has one; expected result is unchanged for these fixtures. This intermediate attempt was aborted because its dynamic different-base assertion was wrong; final benchmark was restarted after source stabilization. No timings from the abandoned attempt are included.

scope: Isolated impact analysis microbenchmark and regression inventory; not a complete Issue-to-PR/Delivery performance acceptance.

limitations: This measures computeImpactSet first/repeat/different-base calls only, not an Issue end-to-end workflow, LLM work, review quality, test execution, CI or delivery.
No provider token usage or cost was collected; no token saving is claimed.
Fresh process per side and repetition; first call includes compiler initialization. Process timing includes loader and process startup. OS caches are not flushed.
Five repetitions are a small sample; p95 is nearest-rank and equals max for n=5.
Run order alternates; shared host load can affect measurements.

benchmark.limitsAfterMeasurement: This benchmark describes the recorded source hashes, not the final integration HEAD; preview snapshots and dynamic require wrappers were corrected later. No end-to-end acceptance is inferred.

methodology.processIsolation: Fresh child process per version and repetition; same isolated Git fixture and exact commits for both versions.
methodology.timing: performance.now; call timers exclude module import; process timer includes startup/import. First call includes TypeScript compiler initialization.
methodology.statistics: Median, nearest-rank p95, max, min. n=5 makes p95 equal max.
methodology.equality: Nine cases compare complete result JSON on every call. Dynamic import first/repeat require baseline targeted and candidate full; differentBase remains full in both versions due to an independently unreachable unrelated file. Candidate first/repeat complete results must match.
methodology.load: Shared host with normal IDE processes; targeted Cucumber suites were observed during earlier attempts. Exact overlap during this final run was not recorded. No dedicated CPU, cache flush, or CPU pinning. No build/compile was started by this benchmark.
methodology.isolation: Fixtures under /tmp with separate HOME, Git config disabled, explicit fixture author identities. No fixture remote or network access is used. Package dependencies are shared through a node_modules symlink.

expectedSafetyDifference.comparability: This case deliberately changes the safety decision, so timing is not an equivalent-result speed comparison.

findings.observation: Same 832-byte handoff appears both at top level and inside 1561-byte dispatch prompt; total printed output 3585 bytes. Three unchanged previews regenerate same workUnitId and dispatch.
findings.proposal: An optional compact dispatch-only output may avoid coordinator context duplication. Preserve existing JSON compatibility and all resume/handoff identity fields; do not add session registry or infer worker completion.

findings.observation: Preview itself starts no worker/LLM and reads no Skill body. It starts two Git commands in short-lived and one in compatible. Agent invocation is a host action outside this CLI.
findings.proposal: Measure actual host launch/model usage with explicit opt-in fixtures before deciding to omit an independent worker or claiming token savings.

findings.observation: Existing distribution CLI cold process elapsed 190.6–232.3ms in five runs; in-process warm preview around 9ms before fix. Source module import measured 259ms separately, not part of the production CLI number.
findings.proposal: Explore lazy command imports or reducing unnecessary separate CLI invocations only after profiling. Avoid a resident daemon.

findings.observation: No live worker/reviewer, provider polling, exact-head long review session or Delivery E2E was measured here. This Step1 fixture cannot establish their dominant cost.
findings.proposal: Use explicit isolated host/provider fixtures for those stages; preserve independent review and trusted gate behavior.
